target.statement: Mean initialization time (ms) for Sector-Mean on the A1 dataset (SIPU A1, N=3000, k=20) is 0.218 ms.

compute.basis: The algorithm is a simple O(N) NumPy operation on 3000 2D points; the main effort is reimplementing the initialization and Lloyd's algorithm from the paper's pseudocode, plus downloading the SIPU A1 dataset.

blockers: No code repository linked; must reimplement Sector-Mean and baselines from pseudocode.
Timing values are hardware-dependent and may not match exactly.
title: Sector-Mean: Deterministic Initialization of K-Means Centroids via Angular Sector Partitioning
